title: AI Assurance and Governance Webinar
summary: Manage agentic AI risk with confidence. Join Xerox IT Solutions to explore practical AI governance, assurance and controls for autonomous AI agents.
body_markdown:
## How are you managing Agentic Risk in your Organization?


Agentic AI moved from pilot to production faster than most governance programs could adjust. An AI agent that can book, buy, write, delete, or escalate on its own represents a fundamentally different risk than a model that simply drafts text — and the review process built for the latter doesn't cover the former. This live session brings business and technical leaders together to work through what practical AI assurance looks like once software can take action independently, with a focus on controls attendees can put in place this quarter.


### AI Assurance and Governance October 13, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


60-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### What you'll learn


-


Why agentic risk behaves differently from model risk, and which current controls quietly stop working.


-


How to discover and inventory the AI agents already operating across your environment.


-


Practical guardrails: least-privilege permissions for agents, human approval checkpoints, and a tested kill switch.


-


What an audit trail needs to contain before a regulator, auditor, or customer asks who approved an agent's action.


-


How other organizations divide accountability for agentic AI across IT, risk, legal, and the business.


#### What's in it for me?


Leave with a working definition of agentic risk you can bring to a board or risk committee, a quick maturity check, and a starter control set — plus the right diligence questions to ask any vendor selling you an AI agent.


Register now
